activeChange: The runner kills and reaps each probe's process group when the checker is interrupted, terminated, hung up or raises. The checker validates the frozen straddle protocol, registers the straddle-repair records beside the original manifest and rejects an executable identity registered twice. The probe replaces a force unwrap with an invalid-argument guard. The straddle-repair records used the runner cleanup (tool revisions dc27db16b2 and af2f3da734); the original records did not. Each record authenticates its tooling by its recorded Git revision. Shipping source bytes match af2f3da7343f2e2145c942e51bd3a0bd13c48180 except Sources/AstronomyKit/Documentation.docc/CoordinateSystems.md, whose example sign issue #149 corrected after these records. check_current_search.py accepts that article only at baseline SHA-256 0b560b86bb7bbe92d7e60571e2b3bb13bf74066ea5a97cbdeb8a1a3282762354 or corrected SHA-256 2e1ffedad9047136400eb37dbb61338e075e4d05319a87650cb9f17d26c82e58; no registered record ran with that version of the check.
